mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of wall insulation installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of wall insulation installation varies widely based on several factors, including the type of insulation chosen, the total area to be insulated, the accessibility of wall cavities, and whether it's new construction or a retrofit project. Spray foam tends to be more expensive per square foot but offers superior performance, while fiberglass and cellulose are generally more budget-friendly. Costs can also be affected by regional labor rates. It's best to get a detailed quote after an on-site assessment to understand the specific investment for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies by insulation type, area size, accessibility, and project complexity. Spray foam is often pricier but effective, while batts/cellulose are more economical.
